name: @xld/monorepo
description: 晓黎团队官网 + CEO 博客系统 Monorepo
author: 晓黎团队

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "homepage,blog-admin,blog-frontend,blog-api,music-api,ws-gateway" -c "cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue,white" "pnpm dev:homepage" "pnpm dev:blog-admin" "pnpm dev:blog-frontend" "pnpm dev:blog-api" "pnpm dev:music" "pnpm dev:ws-gateway"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "homepage,blog-admin,blog-frontend,blog-api,music-api,ws-gateway" -c "cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue,white" "pnpm dev:homepage" "pnpm dev:blog-admin" "pnpm dev:blog-frontend" "pnpm dev:blog-api" "pnpm dev:music" "pnpm dev:ws-gateway"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n "homepage,blog-frontend,blog-api,music-api,ws-gateway" -c "cyan,green,yellow,blue,white" "pnpm dev:homepage:local" "pnpm dev:blog-frontend:local" "pnpm dev:blog-api:local" "pnpm dev:music:local" "pnpm dev:ws-gateway"
scripts.dev:homepage:local: cross-env PORT=80 VITE_BLOG_FRONTEND_PORT=3008 VITE_BLOG_API_PORT=8086 VITE_MUSIC_API_PORT=3005 pnpm --filter homepage dev
scripts.build:blog-api: echo 'Blog API does not require build'
scripts.test: pnpm --filter homepage test && pnpm --filter @xld/shared-utils test && pnpm --filter blog-api test
